data.name: TCS
data.overview: Tata Consultancy Services is a large Indian multinational IT services and consulting company that hires many graduates each year.

rounds.name: Online assessment
rounds.description: Aptitude (quantitative, logical reasoning, verbal) and basic programming questions in a timed online test.

rounds.name: Technical interview
rounds.description: Programming fundamentals, OOP, DBMS/SQL, a short coding exercise and discussion of academic or work projects.

rounds.name: Managerial / HR interview
rounds.description: Communication, teamwork, relocation and shift flexibility, career goals and situational questions.

topics.name: Programming fundamentals
topics.description: Loops, recursion, strings and arrays in your primary language.

topics.name: Object-oriented programming
topics.description: The four pillars, SOLID basics and simple class design.

topics.name: SQL and DBMS
topics.description: Joins, keys, normalisation and simple queries.

topics.name: Web basics
topics.description: HTTP, REST and the request lifecycle.

collections.title: TCS: technical fundamentals practice
collections.description: Practice questions matching the topics this interview style emphasises.

collections.title: TCS: coding practice
collections.description: Coding challenges at the difficulty this interview style typically targets.

collections.title: TCS: HR & behavioural preparation
collections.description: Use the AI mock interview (HR type) with these themes: motivation, teamwork, conflict, learning from failure.

data.disclaimer: Practice content in this section is written by the DevInterview team to match each company's publicly described interview format. Items marked 'Illustrative' or 'Community contributed' are not claims that a specific question was asked in a real interview. Only items marked 'Verified' cite a public source.
